newsitem.title: USA: Eastern Environmental to buy waste hauler.
newsitem.headline: Eastern Environmental to buy waste hauler.

text.p: Eastern Environmental Services Inc said Monday it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire substantially all of the assets of Waste Service Inc for about $26.86 million.
The deal, which is structured as a stock-for-assets transaction, includes Waste Service Inc's affiliated waste hauling companies.

Eastern Environmental said it will pay for the assets by issuing common stock, a portion of which it will register within 120 days after closing. The balance is to be registered 18 months after closing.
Eastern also has agreed to assume an undisclosed amount of Waste Service's debt.
The company said there are no assurances the transaction will close. Waste Service is based in Brooklyn, N.Y.
It did not immediately return a telephone call seeking further information.
